info.title: Aurinko Email
info.description: Curated from https://apirefs.aurinko.io/assets/swagger.json (2026-09-16). Account bearer token required. Mail.Read for reads, Mail.Send for sends, Mail.Drafts for drafts. Send IDs are best effort; Incomplete processing can follow successful submission. Do not blindly retry uncertain sends.

parameters.name: pingProvider
parameters.description: If true, the provider will be pinged to check if the token is still valid. Currently supported only for Google, Office365, Salesforce, NetSuite, IMAP.

active.description: The account is always active in the current API version

tokenStatus.description:
* active - means the token is active and ready for use
* invalid - means that Aurinko failed to access provider API with authentication data.
   Basically it indicates that Aurinko has received a 401 http status from provider and marked this token as non-active.
* dead - this is a special variant of "invalid" status that can occur only with OAuth 2.0 accounts.
   It means that Aurinko failed to refresh OAuth access token and received "invalid_grant" error which indicates
   that the access/refresh tokens pair cannot be used anymore and is basically dead.
   The difference between invalid and dead is that with invalid tokens Aurinko will still try to
   access provider API and with dead Aurinko won't even attempt:
   trying to use dead token, Aurinko will just return 401 without making calls to the provider.

`List` family of email headers to be set. Behavior depends on the provider:
* Google, IMAP: All provided headers are applied to the email as-is.
* Office 365, EWS: Only the `List-Unsubscribe` header is supported.
* Other providers: Headers are currently not supported.
